# Simple Data 


```{r}
# =========================================================
# CHUNK 1: Generate simulation datasets
# =========================================================

set.seed(2026)

n_sims  <- 100
n_subj  <- 100
m_points <- 5
N       <- n_subj * m_points

# True parameters
beta_true         <- c(5, 2, -1.5)
sigma2_true       <- 1.0
random_slope_sd   <- sqrt(1.0)   # adjust to match your DGP
random_intercept_sd <- sqrt(2.0) # adjust to match your DGP

# Fixed design
ID        <- rep(1:n_subj, each = m_points)
Intercept <- rep(1, N)
Var1      <- rep(0:(m_points - 1), n_subj)
Var2      <- rnorm(N, mean = 0, sd = 1)
Des       <- data.frame(ID = ID, Intercept = Intercept, Var1 = Var1, Var2 = Var2)
X         <- as.matrix(Des[, -1])
Z         <- as.matrix(Des[, -1])

B_true <- matrix(c(2.0, 0.5, 0.2,
                   0.5, 1.0, 0.1,
                   0.2, 0.1, 0.5), nrow = 3)

# Generate one dataset per simulation seed
sim_list <- lapply(seq_len(n_sims), function(s) {
  set.seed(2026 + s)
  gamma_true <- MASS::mvrnorm(n_subj, mu = c(0, 0, 0), Sigma = B_true)
  Y <- numeric(N)
  for (i in seq_len(n_subj)) {
    idx        <- which(ID == i)
    epsilon    <- rnorm(length(idx), mean = 0, sd = sqrt(sigma2_true))
    Y[idx]     <- X[idx, ] %*% beta_true + Z[idx, ] %*% gamma_true[i, ] + epsilon
  }
  df      <- cbind(Y = Y, Des)
  df$sim_id <- s
  df
})

cat("Generated", length(sim_list), "datasets.\n")

```


# Functions

# Helper

```{r}
###############################################################################
# EM Algorithm for LMER with optional FastMix-style trimming
#
# Dependencies: base R only (no external packages required)
#
# Functions included (in order):
#   rsolve          - robust matrix inverse via SVD
#   rhalfinv        - robust symmetric matrix half-inverse via eigen
#   Sfunc1          - helper: conditional mean/derivative on truncated normal
#   Sinv1           - helper: Newton-Raphson inversion of Sfunc1
#   sigmaR2         - helper: conditional variance under trimming
#   RobustMeanEst   - trimmed mean with bias correction (from FastMix)
#   cov.est         - bias-corrected covariance estimator (from FastMix)
#   simple_em_lmer  - main EM function with optional FastMix trimming
###############################################################################


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# rsolve: Robust matrix inverse via SVD
#   Truncates singular values below min.cond.num * max(singular value)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
rsolve <- function(X, min.cond.num = 1e-6) {
  o <- svd(X)
  lambda <- min.cond.num * max(o$d)
  dd <- pmax(o$d, lambda)
  if (length(dd) == 1) {
    dd.inv <- 1 / dd
  } else {
    dd.inv <- diag(1 / dd)
  }
  return(o$v %*% dd.inv %*% t(o$u))
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# rhalfinv: Robust half-inverse of a symmetric positive semi-definite matrix
#   Returns X^{-1/2} via eigen decomposition, clamping small eigenvalues
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
rhalfinv <- function(X, min.cond.num = 1e-6) {
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  if (nrow(X) != ncol(X)) stop("X must be a square matrix!")
  if (!isSymmetric(X, tol = 1e-6)) warning("X should be symmetric!")
  if (all(dim(X) == c(1, 1))) {
    return(as.matrix(1 / sqrt(pmax(X, 0))))
  }
  o <- eigen(X, symmetric = TRUE)
  lambda <- min.cond.num * max(o$values)
  dd <- pmax(o$values, lambda)
  return(o$vectors %*% diag(1 / sqrt(dd)) %*% t(o$vectors))
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sfunc1: Computes conditional mean S(mu), its derivative dS, and
#   intermediate quantities for the bias correction in RobustMeanEst.
#   Integrates over a grid on [-R, R] using a trapezoidal approximation.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sfunc1 <- function(mu, R, L, ngrid = 500) {
  dx <- 2 * R / ngrid
  mygrid <- seq(-R, R, dx)
  phi.grid <- dnorm(mygrid - mu)
  Fchi2.grid <- pchisq(R^2 - mygrid^2, L - 1)
  h.grid <- Fchi2.grid * phi.grid
  Bmu <- sum(h.grid) * dx
  Tmu <- sum(h.grid * mygrid) * dx
  Hmu <- sum(h.grid * (mygrid^2)) * dx
  return(c(Tmu = Tmu, Bmu = Bmu, Hmu = Hmu,
           S = Tmu / Bmu,
           dS = (Hmu * Bmu - Tmu^2) / Bmu^2))
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sinv1: Newton-Raphson inversion of Sfunc1
#   Finds mu such that S(mu) = mu1.trim
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sinv1 <- function(mu1.trim, R, L, ngrid = 500, tol = 1e-4, max.iter = 10) {
  k <- 0; err <- Inf; mu1.now <- mu1.trim
  while ((abs(err) > tol) & (k < max.iter)) {
    rk <- Sfunc1(mu1.now, R, L, ngrid = ngrid)
    mu1.next <- mu1.now - (rk[["S"]] - mu1.trim) / rk[["dS"]]
    k <- k + 1
    err <- mu1.next - mu1.now
    mu1.now <- mu1.next
  }
  if (abs(err) > tol)
    warning("Max iterations reached before convergence in Sinv1.")
  return(list(mu1 = mu1.now, niter = k, err = err))
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sigmaR2: Conditional variance of a truncated chi distribution
#   Used to compute the variance inflation factor in RobustMeanEst
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
sigmaR2 <- function(trim, L) {
  pchisq(qchisq(1 - trim, df = L), df = L + 2) / (1 - trim)
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RobustMeanEst: Trimmed mean of gamma_hat with bias correction (FastMix)
#
#   X     : n x q matrix of per-subject random effect estimates (gamma_hat)
#   Sigma : q x q covariance matrix used to standardize X (typically B + sigma2*(ZtZ)^{-1})
#   trim  : fraction to trim (default 0.5, i.e., top 50% by Mahalanobis distance)
#
#   Returns:
#     mu.est       : bias-corrected mean estimate (q-vector)
#     V.inflation  : variance inflation factor for fixed effect t-stats
#     niter, err, R: convergence diagnostics
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
RobustMeanEst <- function(X, Sigma = diag(ncol(X)), trim = 0.5,
                          tol = 1e-2, max.iter = 10) {
  L <- ncol(X)
  S.half.inv <- rhalfinv(Sigma)
  S.half <- rsolve(S.half.inv)

  # Standardize X into isotropic space
  Xtilde <- X %*% S.half.inv
  mus.now <- colMeans(Xtilde)

  k <- 0; err <- Inf
  while ((abs(err) > tol) & (k < max.iter)) {
    Z <- sweep(Xtilde, 2, mus.now)
    ll <- sqrt(rowSums(Z^2))
    R <- as.numeric(quantile(ll, 1 - trim))
    idx <- which(ll <= R)

    if (L == 1) {
      Mvec.trim <- mean(Z[idx, ])
    } else {
      Mvec.trim <- colMeans(Z[idx, , drop = FALSE])
    }

    M.trim <- sqrt(sum(Mvec.trim^2))
    v <- if (M.trim > 0) Mvec.trim / M.trim else Mvec.trim

    o <- Sinv1(M.trim, R, L = L)
    err <- o$mu1
    mus.now <- mus.now + err * v
    k <- k + 1
  }

  mu.est <- drop(S.half %*% mus.now)
  kappa <- if (abs(M.trim) > 0) err / M.trim else 0
  V.inflation <- kappa^2 * sigmaR2(trim, L) / (1 - trim)

  return(list(mu.est = mu.est, niter = k, err = err, R = R,
              V.inflation = V.inflation))
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# cov.est: Bias-corrected covariance estimator (FastMix)
#
#   bmat        : n x q matrix of OLS random effect estimates (gamma_hat stacked)
#   var.epsilon : scalar residual variance estimate (sigma2)
#   xx          : sum of (ZiᵀZi)^{-1} across subjects — the bias correction term
#   m           : number of subjects
#   coef        : q-vector of per-direction scaling coefficients (default all 1s)
#                 In FastMix these are set to lambda.quan in trimmed directions
#
#   The estimator: B = diag(sqrt(coef)) * cov(gamma_hat) * diag(sqrt(coef))
#                      - (sigma2 / m) * sum((ZiᵀZi)^{-1})
#   This subtracts the expected bias from using OLS gamma estimates instead
#   of the true random effects.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cov.est <- function(bmat, var.epsilon, xx, m, coef) {
  vc <- cov(as.matrix(bmat))
  diag(vc) <- diag(vc) * coef           # rescale trimmed directions
  vc <- vc - (1 / m) * var.epsilon * xx # subtract OLS bias
  return(as.matrix(vc))
}

```

# Model 1

```{r}

# =============================================================================
# MODEL 1: em_lmer_combined
# EM with FastMix trimming baked inside every M-step iteration.
# Arguments:
#   do_trim : logical — whether to apply trimming inside the loop
#   trim    : fraction of subjects trimmed each iteration (default 0.5)
# =============================================================================
em_lmer_combined <- function(Y, Des,
                             random       = "all",
                             iter         = 100,
                             lambda_ridge = 1,
                             do_trim      = FALSE,
                             trim         = 0.5) {

  Y  <- as.matrix(Y); M <- nrow(Y)
  X  <- as.matrix(Des[, -1]); p <- ncol(X)
  if (length(random) == 1 && random == "all") random <- 1:p
  DZ       <- Des[, c(1, random + 1)]
  n_subj   <- length(unique(Des[, 1]))
  ID       <- sort(unique(Des[, 1]))
  idx_list <- lapply(ID, function(id) which(Des[, 1] == id))
  q        <- length(random)

  # Initialization
  beta_ols      <- lm.fit(x = X, y = Y)$coefficients
  residuals_ols <- Y - X %*% beta_ols
  sigma2_k      <- max(sum(residuals_ols^2) / (M - p), 1e-6)
  gamma_hat     <- vector("list", n_subj)
  B_init        <- matrix(0, q, q)
  for (i in seq_len(n_subj)) {
    idx            <- idx_list[[i]]
    Zi             <- as.matrix(DZ[idx, -1, drop = FALSE])
    Ri             <- residuals_ols[idx]
    gamma_hat[[i]] <- rsolve(t(Zi) %*% Zi + lambda_ridge * diag(q)) %*% t(Zi) %*% Ri
    B_init         <- B_init + gamma_hat[[i]] %*% t(gamma_hat[[i]])
  }
  B_init <- B_init / n_subj
  eig    <- eigen(B_init)
  eig$values[eig$values < 1e-6] <- 1e-6
  B_k    <- eig$vectors %*% diag(eig$values) %*% t(eig$vectors)

  B_inv         <- rsolve(B_k)
  Sigma_Ui_list <- vector("list", n_subj)
  for (i in seq_len(n_subj)) {
    idx                <- idx_list[[i]]
    Zi                 <- as.matrix(DZ[idx, -1, drop = FALSE])
    Sigma_Ui_list[[i]] <- sigma2_k * rsolve(sigma2_k * B_inv + t(Zi) %*% Zi)
  }

  # Pre-compute (Zi'Zi)^{-1} for trimming bias correction
  xx_list <- lapply(seq_len(n_subj), function(i) {
    Zi <- as.matrix(DZ[idx_list[[i]], -1, drop = FALSE])
    rsolve(t(Zi) %*% Zi)
  })
  XX_sum <- Reduce("+", xx_list)

  beta_history   <- vector("list", iter)
  B_history      <- vector("list", iter)
  gamma_history  <- vector("list", iter)
  sigma2_history <- vector("list", iter)

  for (it in seq_len(iter)) {

    # M-step: beta
    Y_star <- numeric(M)
    for (i in seq_len(n_subj)) {
      idx         <- idx_list[[i]]
      Y_star[idx] <- Y[idx] - as.matrix(DZ[idx, -1, drop = FALSE]) %*% gamma_hat[[i]]
    }
    beta_k <- lm.fit(x = X, y = Y_star)$coefficients

    # M-step: sigma2
    rss <- 0
    for (i in seq_len(n_subj)) {
      idx  <- idx_list[[i]]
      Xi   <- as.matrix(X[idx, , drop = FALSE])
      Zi   <- as.matrix(DZ[idx, -1, drop = FALSE])
      ri   <- as.matrix(Y[idx]) - Xi %*% beta_k - Zi %*% gamma_hat[[i]]
      rss  <- rss + sum(ri^2) + sum(diag(Zi %*% Sigma_Ui_list[[i]] %*% t(Zi)))
    }
    sigma2_k <- max(rss / M, 1e-6)

    # M-step: B (plain or trimmed)
    if (!do_trim) {
      B_k <- matrix(0, q, q)
      for (i in seq_len(n_subj))
        B_k <- B_k + gamma_hat[[i]] %*% t(gamma_hat[[i]]) + Sigma_Ui_list[[i]]
      B_k <- B_k / n_subj

    } else {
      # Compute Mahalanobis-style distances using current B
      S_half_inv <- rhalfinv(B_k)
      gamma_mat  <- do.call(rbind, lapply(gamma_hat, as.vector))
      chi_stat   <- rowSums((gamma_mat %*% S_half_inv)^2)
      
      # Fixed theoretical cutoff — same threshold every iteration
      cutoff   <- qchisq(1 - trim, df = q)
      trim_idx <- which(chi_stat <= cutoff)
      n_keep   <- length(trim_idx)
    
      if (n_keep < 2) {
        # Fallback: use all subjects
        B_k <- matrix(0, q, q)
        for (i in seq_len(n_subj))
          B_k <- B_k + gamma_hat[[i]] %*% t(gamma_hat[[i]]) + Sigma_Ui_list[[i]]
        B_k <- B_k / n_subj
      } else {
        # B update uses only inlier subjects
        B_k <- matrix(0, q, q)
        for (i in trim_idx)
          B_k <- B_k + gamma_hat[[i]] %*% t(gamma_hat[[i]]) + Sigma_Ui_list[[i]]
        B_k <- B_k / n_keep
        
        # Inflate to correct for truncation bias
        inflation <- (1 - trim) / pchisq(cutoff, df = q + 2)
        B_k       <- B_k * inflation
      }
    }
    B_k <- (B_k + t(B_k)) / 2
    eig <- eigen(B_k)
    eig$values[eig$values < 1e-6] <- 1e-6
    B_k <- eig$vectors %*% diag(eig$values) %*% t(eig$vectors)

    # E-step
    B_inv <- rsolve(B_k)
    for (i in seq_len(n_subj)) {
      idx     <- idx_list[[i]]
      Yi      <- as.matrix(Y[idx])
      Xi      <- as.matrix(X[idx, , drop = FALSE])
      Zi      <- as.matrix(DZ[idx, -1, drop = FALSE])
      resid_i <- Yi - Xi %*% beta_k
      inner_inv          <- rsolve(sigma2_k * B_inv + t(Zi) %*% Zi)
      Sigma_Ui_list[[i]] <- sigma2_k * inner_inv
      Vi_inv_r           <- (1 / sigma2_k) *
        (resid_i - Zi %*% inner_inv %*% t(Zi) %*% resid_i)
      gamma_hat[[i]]     <- B_k %*% t(Zi) %*% Vi_inv_r
    }

    beta_history[[it]]   <- beta_k
    B_history[[it]]      <- B_k
    gamma_history[[it]]  <- gamma_hat
    sigma2_history[[it]] <- sigma2_k
  }

  return(list(
    beta_history        = beta_history,
    Sigma_gamma_history = B_history,
    gamma_history       = gamma_history,
    sigma2_history      = sigma2_history
  ))
}

```

# Model 2 A

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# MODEL 2a: em_lmer_plain
# Plain EM to convergence, no trimming. Output used as input to em_fastmix_trim.
# =============================================================================
em_lmer_plain <- function(Y, Des,
                          random       = "all",
                          iter         = 100,
                          lambda_ridge = 1) {

  Y  <- as.matrix(Y); M <- nrow(Y)
  X  <- as.matrix(Des[, -1]); p <- ncol(X)
  if (length(random) == 1 && random == "all") random <- 1:p
  DZ       <- Des[, c(1, random + 1)]
  n_subj   <- length(unique(Des[, 1]))
  ID       <- sort(unique(Des[, 1]))
  idx_list <- lapply(ID, function(id) which(Des[, 1] == id))
  q        <- length(random)

  # Initialization
  beta_ols      <- lm.fit(x = X, y = Y)$coefficients
  residuals_ols <- Y - X %*% beta_ols
  sigma2_k      <- max(sum(residuals_ols^2) / (M - p), 1e-6)
  gamma_hat     <- vector("list", n_subj)
  B_init        <- matrix(0, q, q)
  for (i in seq_len(n_subj)) {
    idx            <- idx_list[[i]]
    Zi             <- as.matrix(DZ[idx, -1, drop = FALSE])
    Ri             <- residuals_ols[idx]
    gamma_hat[[i]] <- rsolve(t(Zi) %*% Zi + lambda_ridge * diag(q)) %*% t(Zi) %*% Ri
    B_init         <- B_init + gamma_hat[[i]] %*% t(gamma_hat[[i]])
  }
  B_init <- B_init / n_subj
  eig    <- eigen(B_init)
  eig$values[eig$values < 1e-6] <- 1e-6
  B_k    <- eig$vectors %*% diag(eig$values) %*% t(eig$vectors)

  B_inv         <- rsolve(B_k)
  Sigma_Ui_list <- vector("list", n_subj)
  for (i in seq_len(n_subj)) {
    idx                <- idx_list[[i]]
    Zi                 <- as.matrix(DZ[idx, -1, drop = FALSE])
    Sigma_Ui_list[[i]] <- sigma2_k * rsolve(sigma2_k * B_inv + t(Zi) %*% Zi)
  }

  beta_history   <- vector("list", iter)
  B_history      <- vector("list", iter)
  gamma_history  <- vector("list", iter)
  sigma2_history <- vector("list", iter)

  for (it in seq_len(iter)) {

    # M-step: beta
    Y_star <- numeric(M)
    for (i in seq_len(n_subj)) {
      idx         <- idx_list[[i]]
      Y_star[idx] <- Y[idx] - as.matrix(DZ[idx, -1, drop = FALSE]) %*% gamma_hat[[i]]
    }
    beta_k <- lm.fit(x = X, y = Y_star)$coefficients

    # M-step: sigma2
    rss <- 0
    for (i in seq_len(n_subj)) {
      idx  <- idx_list[[i]]
      Xi   <- as.matrix(X[idx, , drop = FALSE])
      Zi   <- as.matrix(DZ[idx, -1, drop = FALSE])
      ri   <- as.matrix(Y[idx]) - Xi %*% beta_k - Zi %*% gamma_hat[[i]]
      rss  <- rss + sum(ri^2) + sum(diag(Zi %*% Sigma_Ui_list[[i]] %*% t(Zi)))
    }
    sigma2_k <- max(rss / M, 1e-6)

    # M-step: B
    B_k <- matrix(0, q, q)
    for (i in seq_len(n_subj))
      B_k <- B_k + gamma_hat[[i]] %*% t(gamma_hat[[i]]) + Sigma_Ui_list[[i]]
    B_k <- B_k / n_subj
    B_k <- (B_k + t(B_k)) / 2
    eig <- eigen(B_k)
    eig$values[eig$values < 1e-6] <- 1e-6
    B_k <- eig$vectors %*% diag(eig$values) %*% t(eig$vectors)

    # E-step
    B_inv <- rsolve(B_k)
    for (i in seq_len(n_subj)) {
      idx     <- idx_list[[i]]
      Yi      <- as.matrix(Y[idx])
      Xi      <- as.matrix(X[idx, , drop = FALSE])
      Zi      <- as.matrix(DZ[idx, -1, drop = FALSE])
      resid_i <- Yi - Xi %*% beta_k
      inner_inv          <- rsolve(sigma2_k * B_inv + t(Zi) %*% Zi)
      Sigma_Ui_list[[i]] <- sigma2_k * inner_inv
      Vi_inv_r           <- (1 / sigma2_k) *
        (resid_i - Zi %*% inner_inv %*% t(Zi) %*% resid_i)
      gamma_hat[[i]]     <- B_k %*% t(Zi) %*% Vi_inv_r
    }

    beta_history[[it]]   <- beta_k
    B_history[[it]]      <- B_k
    gamma_history[[it]]  <- gamma_hat
    sigma2_history[[it]] <- sigma2_k
  }

  # Return histories + final values needed by em_fastmix_trim
  return(list(
    beta_history        = beta_history,
    Sigma_gamma_history = B_history,
    gamma_history       = gamma_history,
    sigma2_history      = sigma2_history,
    beta                = beta_k,
    B                   = B_k,
    sigma2              = sigma2_k,
    gamma_hat           = gamma_hat,
    Sigma_Ui            = Sigma_Ui_list,
    idx_list            = idx_list,
    random              = random,
    q                   = q,
    Des                 = Des,
    Y                   = Y,
    X                   = X,
    DZ                  = DZ
  ))
}
```

```{r}
# Helper function: Calculates exact theoretical cutoff and covariance inflation
get_cov_inflation <- function(q, trim_prop) {
  # Find the Chi-Square distance cutoff (e.g., 95th percentile)
  c_thresh <- qchisq(1 - trim_prop, df = q)
  # Exact theoretical inflation factor for truncated Chi-Square covariance
  inflation <- (1 - trim_prop) / pchisq(c_thresh, df = q + 2)
  return(list(cutoff = c_thresh, inflation = inflation))
}

# =============================================================================
# MODEL 2b: em_fastmix_trim (CORRECTED)
# Post-hoc FastMix trimming pass on output of em_lmer_plain.
# =============================================================================
em_fastmix_trim <- function(em_fit, trim = 0.05) {

  B         <- em_fit$B
  sigma2    <- em_fit$sigma2
  beta      <- em_fit$beta
  gamma_hat <- em_fit$gamma_hat
  Sigma_Ui  <- em_fit$Sigma_Ui
  idx_list  <- em_fit$idx_list
  X         <- em_fit$X
  Y         <- em_fit$Y
  DZ        <- em_fit$DZ
  n_subj    <- length(gamma_hat)
  q         <- em_fit$q

  # 1. Convert EBLUPs to a matrix
  gamma_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(gamma_hat, as.vector))
  
  # 2. Get exact theoretical cutoff and inflation multiplier
  infl_info <- get_cov_inflation(q, trim)
  
  # 3. Calculate squared Mahalanobis distances
  S.half.inv  <- rhalfinv(B)
  chi_stat <- rowSums((gamma_mat %*% S.half.inv)^2)
  
  # 4. Identify safe subjects using the theoretical cutoff
  trim_idx    <- which(chi_stat <= infl_info$cutoff)
  outlier_idx <- which(chi_stat > infl_info$cutoff)
  n_keep      <- length(trim_idx)

  if (n_keep < 2) {
    warning("Too few subjects retained. Returning unchanged.")
    em_fit$B_trimmed <- B
    return(em_fit)
  }

  # 5. Calculate trimmed covariance using ONLY the safe subjects
  # (Proper EM update: EBLUP outer product + Posterior Variance)
  B_trimmed <- matrix(0, q, q)
  for (i in trim_idx) {
    B_trimmed <- B_trimmed + (gamma_hat[[i]] %*% t(gamma_hat[[i]])) + Sigma_Ui[[i]]
  }
  B_trimmed <- B_trimmed / n_keep
  
  # 6. Apply the EXACT theoretical FastMix inflation factor
  B_trimmed <- B_trimmed * infl_info$inflation

  # Enforce positive definiteness
  B_trimmed <- (B_trimmed + t(B_trimmed)) / 2
  eig       <- eigen(B_trimmed)
  eig$values[eig$values < 1e-6] <- 1e-6
  B_trimmed <- eig$vectors %*% diag(eig$values) %*% t(eig$vectors)

  # 7. Recalculate EBLUPs (gamma) using the newly corrected B matrix
  B_trimmed_inv  <- rsolve(B_trimmed)
  gamma_hat_new  <- vector("list", n_subj)
  Sigma_Ui_new   <- vector("list", n_subj)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_subj)) {
    idx     <- idx_list[[i]]
    Yi      <- as.matrix(Y[idx])
    Xi      <- as.matrix(X[idx, , drop = FALSE])
    Zi      <- as.matrix(DZ[idx, -1, drop = FALSE])
    resid_i <- Yi - Xi %*% beta
    
    inner_inv          <- rsolve(sigma2 * B_trimmed_inv + t(Zi) %*% Zi)
    Sigma_Ui_new[[i]]  <- sigma2 * inner_inv
    Vi_inv_r           <- (1 / sigma2) * (resid_i - Zi %*% inner_inv %*% t(Zi) %*% resid_i)
    gamma_hat_new[[i]] <- B_trimmed %*% t(Zi) %*% Vi_inv_r
  }

  # Package and return
  em_fit$B_trimmed         <- B_trimmed
  em_fit$gamma_hat_trimmed <- gamma_hat_new
  em_fit$Sigma_Ui_trimmed  <- Sigma_Ui_new
  em_fit$trim_idx          <- trim_idx
  em_fit$outlier_idx       <- outlier_idx
  
  return(em_fit)
}
```

```{r}
})
```

# Fancy Data Generation


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# generate_sim_data
# 
# Arguments:
#   n_subj       : number of subjects
#   m_points     : observations per subject
#   n_cov        : number of covariates (excluding intercept)
#   beta_true    : fixed effects vector, length = 1 + n_cov (intercept + covariates)
#   B_true       : (1+n_cov) x (1+n_cov) random effects covariance matrix
#   sigma2_true  : residual variance
#   outlier_pct  : fraction of subjects that are outliers (e.g., 0.10 = 10%)
#   outlier_mag  : multiplier on the SD of each random effect for the shift size
#   balance      : "symmetric"  — outliers split ~50/50 positive/negative
#                  "positive"   — outliers shifted mostly positive
#                  "negative"   — outliers shifted mostly negative
#   pos_prob     : when balance != "symmetric", prob of a positive shift (default 0.9)
#   seed         : random seed
# =============================================================================
generate_sim_data <- function(n_subj       = 100,
                              m_points     = 5,
                              n_cov        = 2,
                              beta_true    = NULL,
                              B_true       = NULL,
                              sigma2_true  = 1.0,
                              outlier_pct  = 0.10,
                              outlier_mag  = 3.5,
                              balance      = "symmetric",
                              pos_prob     = 0.9,
                              seed         = 2026) {

  set.seed(seed)
  q <- 1 + n_cov  # intercept + covariates

  # --- Default beta: intercept 5, rest drawn from N(0,1) --------------------
  if (is.null(beta_true)) {
    beta_true <- c(5, rnorm(n_cov))
  }
  stopifnot(length(beta_true) == q)

  # --- Default B: diagonal with moderate variance ---------------------------
  if (is.null(B_true)) {
    B_true <- diag(seq(2.0, 0.5, length.out = q))
  }
  stopifnot(all(dim(B_true) == c(q, q)))

  N  <- n_subj * m_points
  ID <- rep(1:n_subj, each = m_points)

  # --- Build design matrix --------------------------------------------------
  # Intercept + n_cov continuous covariates (time + random noise columns)
  cov_list <- vector("list", n_cov)
  for (j in seq_len(n_cov)) {
    if (j == 1) {
      # First covariate is a time-like variable
      cov_list[[j]] <- rep(0:(m_points - 1), n_subj)
    } else {
      cov_list[[j]] <- rnorm(N)
    }
  }
  cov_names <- paste0("Var", seq_len(n_cov))
  Des <- data.frame(
    ID        = ID,
    Intercept = 1,
    setNames(as.data.frame(do.call(cbind, cov_list)), cov_names)
  )
  X <- as.matrix(Des[, -1])

  # --- Determine outlier subjects -------------------------------------------
  n_out    <- round(n_subj * outlier_pct)
  out_idx  <- if (n_out > 0) sample(seq_len(n_subj), n_out) else integer(0)
  is_out   <- seq_len(n_subj) %in% out_idx

  # --- Draw baseline gamma (random effects) for ALL subjects ----------------
  gamma_true <- MASS::mvrnorm(n_subj, mu = rep(0, q), Sigma = B_true)

  # --- Compute per-direction shift size (outlier_mag * SD of each RE) -------
  re_sd  <- sqrt(diag(B_true))
  shift  <- outlier_mag * re_sd   # length-q vector

  # --- Assign direction of shift per outlier subject ------------------------
  if (n_out > 0) {
    p_pos <- switch(balance,
      "symmetric" = 0.5,
      "positive"  = pos_prob,
      "negative"  = 1 - pos_prob,
      stop("balance must be 'symmetric', 'positive', or 'negative'")
    )
    # Each outlier subject gets a sign per random effect dimension
    signs <- matrix(
      2 * rbinom(n_out * q, size = 1, prob = p_pos) - 1,
      nrow = n_out, ncol = q
    )
    # Apply shift: sweep adds shift vector across columns, then multiply by signs
    gamma_true[out_idx, ] <- gamma_true[out_idx, ] +
      sweep(signs, 2, shift, "*")
  }

  # --- Generate Y -----------------------------------------------------------
  Y <- numeric(N)
  for (i in seq_len(n_subj)) {
    idx       <- which(ID == i)
    epsilon   <- rnorm(length(idx), mean = 0, sd = sqrt(sigma2_true))
    Y[idx]    <- X[idx, ] %*% beta_true + X[idx, ] %*% gamma_true[i, ] + epsilon
  }

  # --- Pack up and return ---------------------------------------------------
  df         <- cbind(Y = Y, Des)
  df$is_out  <- rep(is_out, each = m_points)  # flag for diagnostics

  return(list(
    data        = df,
    Des         = Des,
    Y           = Y,
    X           = X,
    gamma_true  = gamma_true,
    beta_true   = beta_true,
    B_true      = B_true,
    sigma2_true = sigma2_true,
    out_idx     = out_idx,
    is_out      = is_out,
    n_out       = n_out,
    q           = q,
    n_subj      = n_subj,
    m_points    = m_points
  ))
}
```

# Run Gauntlet

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CHUNK: run_all_models — now takes m_points so lmer formula stays correct
# and EM functions get the right design matrix columns
# =============================================================================

run_all_models <- function(sim_list, em_iter, trim_levels, m_points) {

  des_cols <- c("ID", "Intercept", "Var1", "Var2")

  # --- Trim-invariant: Plain EM ---------------------------------------------
  cat("    [trim-invariant] plain EM...\n")
  res_plain <- future_lapply(sim_list, function(df) {
    res <- em_lmer_plain(
      df$Y,
      df[, des_cols],
      random = "all", iter = em_iter, lambda_ridge = 1
    )
    list(
      beta     = as.numeric(res$beta_history[[em_iter]]),
      B        = res$Sigma_gamma_history[[em_iter]],
      gamma    = lapply(res$gamma_history[[em_iter]], as.numeric),
      sigma2   = as.numeric(res$sigma2_history[[em_iter]]),
      full_fit = res,
      sim_id   = df$sim_id[1]
    )
  }, future.seed = TRUE)

  # --- Trim-invariant: lmer -------------------------------------------------
  cat("    [trim-invariant] lmer...\n")
  res_lmer <- future_lapply(sim_list, function(df) {
    lmer_model <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
      lmer(Y ~ Var1 + Var2 + (1 + Var1 + Var2 | ID),
           data    = df,
           REML    = FALSE,
           control = lmerControl(calc.derivs = FALSE))
    ))
    list(
      beta   = as.numeric(fixef(lmer_model)),
      B      = as.matrix(VarCorr(lmer_model)$ID),
      gamma  = as.matrix(ranef(lmer_model)$ID),
      sigma2 = sigma(lmer_model)^2,
      sim_id = df$sim_id[1]
    )
  }, future.packages = c("lme4"), future.seed = TRUE)

  # --- Trim-sensitive: one pass per trim level ------------------------------
  res_by_trim <- lapply(trim_levels, function(tv) {
    cat("    [trim =", tv, "] combined + twostage...\n")

    r_combined <- future_lapply(sim_list, function(df) {
      res <- em_lmer_combined(
        df$Y,
        df[, des_cols],
        random = "all", iter = em_iter, lambda_ridge = 1,
        do_trim = TRUE, trim = tv
      )
      list(
        beta   = as.numeric(res$beta_history[[em_iter]]),
        B      = res$Sigma_gamma_history[[em_iter]],
        gamma  = lapply(res$gamma_history[[em_iter]], as.numeric),
        sigma2 = as.numeric(res$sigma2_history[[em_iter]]),
        sim_id = df$sim_id[1]
      )
    }, future.seed = TRUE)

    r_twostage <- future_lapply(seq_along(sim_list), function(s) {
      res_ts <- em_fastmix_trim(res_plain[[s]]$full_fit, trim = tv)
      list(
        beta   = as.numeric(res_plain[[s]]$full_fit$beta_history[[em_iter]]),
        B      = res_ts$B_trimmed,
        gamma  = lapply(res_ts$gamma_hat_trimmed, as.numeric),
        sigma2 = as.numeric(res_plain[[s]]$full_fit$sigma2_history[[em_iter]]),
        sim_id = sim_list[[s]]$sim_id[1]
      )
    }, future.seed = TRUE)

    list(combined = r_combined, twostage = r_twostage)
  })
  names(res_by_trim) <- paste0("trim", trim_levels * 100)

  list(plain = res_plain, lmer = res_lmer, by_trim = res_by_trim)
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CHUNK: Run the gauntlet
# =============================================================================

EM_ITER     <- 30
TRIM_LEVELS <- c(0.025, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20)
n_cores     <- availableCores() - 2
plan(multisession, workers = n_cores)

gauntlet_results <- vector("list", length(gauntlet))
names(gauntlet_results) <- names(gauntlet)

for (scen_name in names(gauntlet)) {
  scen <- gauntlet[[scen_name]]
  cat("\n[Scenario:", scen_name, "]", scen$label, "\n")
  t0 <- Sys.time()

  gauntlet_results[[scen_name]] <- run_all_models(
    sim_list    = scenario_sim_lists[[scen_name]],
    em_iter     = EM_ITER,
    trim_levels = TRIM_LEVELS,
    m_points    = scen$m_points
  )

  cat("  Done in", round(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"), 1), "secs\n")
  gc()
}

cat("\nAll scenarios complete.\n")
```

# Results Gauntlet


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CHUNK: compute_scenario_rmse — reads n_subj and m_points from scenario
# =============================================================================

compute_scenario_rmse <- function(model_results, sim_list, trim_levels,
                                  scen) {
  n_subj_s   <- scen$n_subj
  m_points_s <- scen$m_points

  # Recover gamma_true per sim using same seed and same scenario geometry
  gamma_true_list <- lapply(seq_along(sim_list), function(s) {
    obj <- generate_sim_data(
      n_subj      = n_subj_s,
      m_points    = m_points_s,
      n_cov       = 2,
      beta_true   = beta_true,
      B_true      = B_true,
      sigma2_true = sigma2_true,
      outlier_pct = 0,
      seed        = 2026 + s
    )
    obj$gamma_true
  })

  get_rmse <- function(res_list, type) {
    mean(sapply(seq_along(sim_list), function(s) {
      gamma_true <- gamma_true_list[[s]]
      r <- res_list[[s]]
      if (type == "beta") {
        sqrt(mean((r$beta - beta_true)^2))
      } else if (type == "cov") {
        sqrt(mean((r$B - B_true)^2))
      } else {
        gmat <- if (is.matrix(r$gamma)) r$gamma
                else do.call(rbind, r$gamma)
        sqrt(mean((gmat - gamma_true)^2))
      }
    }))
  }

  base_row <- c(
    beta_plain  = get_rmse(model_results$plain, "beta"),
    beta_lmer   = get_rmse(model_results$lmer,  "beta"),
    cov_plain   = get_rmse(model_results$plain, "cov"),
    cov_lmer    = get_rmse(model_results$lmer,  "cov"),
    gamma_plain = get_rmse(model_results$plain, "gamma"),
    gamma_lmer  = get_rmse(model_results$lmer,  "gamma")
  )

  trim_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(trim_levels, function(tv) {
    key <- paste0("trim", tv * 100)
    bt  <- model_results$by_trim[[key]]
    c(
      trim           = tv,
      beta_combined  = get_rmse(bt$combined,  "beta"),
      beta_twostage  = get_rmse(bt$twostage,  "beta"),
      cov_combined   = get_rmse(bt$combined,  "cov"),
      cov_twostage   = get_rmse(bt$twostage,  "cov"),
      gamma_combined = get_rmse(bt$combined,  "gamma"),
      gamma_twostage = get_rmse(bt$twostage,  "gamma")
    )
  }))

  list(base = base_row, by_trim = as.data.frame(trim_rows))
}

# Build summary — pass full scen object so geometry is available
rmse_summary <- lapply(names(gauntlet), function(scen_name) {
  compute_scenario_rmse(
    model_results = gauntlet_results[[scen_name]],
    sim_list      = scenario_sim_lists[[scen_name]],
    trim_levels   = TRIM_LEVELS,
    scen          = gauntlet[[scen_name]]
  )
})
names(rmse_summary) <- names(gauntlet)


# =============================================================================
# CHUNK: Print results — scenario block with trim-level breakdown
# =============================================================================

SEP  <- paste0(rep("=", 82), collapse = "")
THIN <- paste0(rep("-", 82), collapse = "")

for (scen_name in names(gauntlet)) {

  scen <- gauntlet[[scen_name]]
  smry <- rmse_summary[[scen_name]]
  base <- smry$base
  bt   <- smry$by_trim

  cat("\n", SEP, "\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf(" Scenario: %s\n", scen$label))
  cat(sprintf(" outlier_pct = %.0f%%  |  outlier_mag = %.1f  |  balance = %s\n",
              scen$outlier_pct * 100, scen$outlier_mag, scen$balance))
  cat(SEP, "\n\n", sep = "")

  # Header
  cat(sprintf("  %-14s  %10s  %10s  %10s  %10s\n",
              "Trim %", "Combined", "Plain EM", "Two-Stage", "lmer"))
  cat(THIN, "\n", sep = "")

  # Beta RMSE
  cat(" Beta RMSE:\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(bt))) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-14s  %10.6f  %10.6f  %10.6f  %10.6f\n",
                paste0(bt$trim[i] * 100, "%"),
                bt$beta_combined[i],
                base["beta_plain"],
                bt$beta_twostage[i],
                base["beta_lmer"]))
  }

  # Covariance B RMSE
  cat("\n Covariance B RMSE:\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(bt))) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-14s  %10.6f  %10.6f  %10.6f  %10.6f\n",
                paste0(bt$trim[i] * 100, "%"),
                bt$cov_combined[i],
                base["cov_plain"],
                bt$cov_twostage[i],
                base["cov_lmer"]))
  }

  # Gamma RMSE
  cat("\n Random Effects RMSE:\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(bt))) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-14s  %10.6f  %10.6f  %10.6f  %10.6f\n",
                paste0(bt$trim[i] * 100, "%"),
                bt$gamma_combined[i],
                base["gamma_plain"],
                bt$gamma_twostage[i],
                base["gamma_lmer"]))
  }

  cat("\n")
}

cat(SEP, "\n", sep = "")
```
